reviewed_by: Codex focused review of Nebula-wide Butler scheduling, authority, file management API, Markdown editor, and product-help paths
reason: Fifteen selected Python cases cover the user-owned instruction reader, global clock and capabilities, authenticated file create/update/conflict/repair, settings API discovery, and bundled Chroma source-digest sync. Thirty-six frontend cases cover Oversight, assistant action routing, and the shared Markdown editor entry, preview, save, conflict, and upload draft. The eight catalogued real-Core browser entries exercise the same scheduled and file-management journey at desktop and mobile widths with a production bundle and synthetic LAN Core.
exclusions: No native code changed, so native tests are excluded. Unrelated Python and frontend suites, unrelated Playwright areas, and full suites are excluded. Physical-device Safari is unavailable; mobile WebKit runs in browser emulation. The inert local model verifies scheduling and roster inspection; no real provider spending or external project data is involved.
